trackerLog.subject: Asteria

feature.notes: User rewrite 2026-09-11. Single ending still Act 13. After the last fight Cael sadly accepts the office the world names God of Life; that office is God of Death. Liraen becomes the new Goddess of Life. Together and separate: mirrored offices, not a household, not a kiss, not a marriage. Predecessor God of Life is Vortan (FEAT-049). Vorath is a misspeak; do not mint it. Plug/seal thesis is not deleted: Nyxara sealed, Cannon spiked as a plug, world scarred and standing. This succession is the last image. No second ending. Do not kill either lead.

Act 13 rails in the Deep Maze Fissure stand. Last image is the Life/Death succession. Open: last-fight body stays Nyxara (FEAT-050 lock) or becomes Vortan (user line after defeating Vortan). Do not silently drop Nyxara. Do not rename Vortan.

Forge-King Vortan surface stands. Add: he is the previous God of Life. The Cannon and undeath are what that office became. Name is Vortan only. Face two of three. Not automatically the Act 13 last fight until FEAT-044 last-body is accepted.
End office: God of Death worn under the name God of Life. He accepts it sadly. Plot armor through the seal. Romance remains Liraen only, together-but-separate after Act 13.
End office: new Goddess of Life. Together-but-separate with Cael. She does not narrate the romance. Plot armor through the seal.

trackerLog.decision: Act 13 ending beat: Cael accepts God of Death under the name God of Life. Liraen becomes Goddess of Life. Together, separate, mirrored offices.
Predecessor God of Life is Vortan. Do not use Vorath.
Single ending remains. Nyxara-sealed / Cannon-plug thesis is not deleted. Last-fight body (Nyxara vs Vortan) stays open on FEAT-044.
